title: QBR Companion: Actionable Trade-offs, Runway Scenarios & Stakeholder Ask Matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description: Assemble a compact executive-ready packet to accompany the QBR: prioritize 3 mission lanes, surface runway scenarios (base / conservative / aggressive), quantify risks and mitigations, and produce a clear stakeholder ask matrix with owners and decision points. This packet will be used in the March exec dry-run and the formal April QBR.
acceptance_criteria: One-page mission lane summary for each proposed lane (why it matters, key metrics, top 3 workstreams)
Runway scenarios with expected spend and velocity impacts (3 scenarios, modeled for 6 months)
Risk heatmap with mitigations and escalation owners
Stakeholder ask matrix with clear decision asks, required approvals, and ETA for each ask
Slides + one-paragraph brief + linkable source artifacts (PRD, design deck, runtime cost model, dashboard snapshots)
